reviews.title: Advert after advert
reviews.text: Intrusive adverts play before anything else starts that you have to reject. Once music starts the adverts play over each other all the time. The DJs constantly plug their weekly lottery. In between this it does play rock music

reviews.title: Rather use Planet Rock
reviews.text:
Much prefer the plant rock app to the generic Rayo! Only get the content I want and not the rest off the network..
Shame about the adverts at the start, when I pay for no adverts!

reviews.title: No sound
reviews.text: I am paying monthly but often it doesn't work WHY ?

reviews.title: No Portrait Mode
reviews.text:
App works fine but on an iPad it only works in Landscape mode which is a right PITA. Come on how hard is it to support auto rotation to whatever orientation the device is being held? It's like going back to the 1980s.....

After a few days I got fed up with not only App adverts but also those on the radio. Deleted app and will look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Where’s the rock
reviews.text: If I wanted to listen to the Beatles I’d have tuned into a pop station

reviews.title: Review pop ups
reviews.text: Love the app. But almost every time I open it I get a review request.

reviews.title: Opens up with advertising. WWon’t use
Station often malfunctions
reviews.text: Often on Planet Rock, adverts will play over the top of music, songs will cut out halfway through. No it’s not my signal, it’s on their end!

reviews.title: Need an account now
reviews.text: Great music, too many adverts. App has always been a bit rubbish but I put up with it for the music, now I need an account to listen to what is a free to air station, why? I’m not doing it, app deleted.

reviews.title: What is wrong with the App?
reviews.text: Cannot log on as the App just crashes???

reviews.title: Don’t want to log in
reviews.text: The app used to be ok but now they want me to have an account and log in to listen! No thanks!

reviews.title: Intrusive
reviews.text: Every time I get into my vehicle and my phone connects to my stereo, the radio app starts playing. This happens regardless of whether the radio app was the last thing I listened to or not. I can’t find a way to stop this. I don’t want this to happen as I find it very intrusive. Please tell me how to stop this
